mapper.sql: create_time , update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, project_id, supplier_id, price_type, price, tax, user_id, user_name
mapper.select: select sp.id, CASE sp.bool_personal_enum WHEN 1 THEN s.name WHEN 0 then sp.license_plate END name, sp.bool_personal_enum from mes_enclosure_supplier_price sp left join contract_project p on p.id = sp.project_id left join scm_supplier s on s.id = sp.supplier_id where sp.bool_delete_enum = 0 and sp.project_id = #{projectId} order by sp.bool_personal_enum desc
